summary: Preserve single LHS reference evaluation, getter/setter effects, undefined/null test, and conditional RHS evaluation for ??=.

semantics.evaluation: evaluate object and key once to form reference; GetValue once
semantics.condition: assign only when current value is null or undefined
semantics.set: PutValue may invoke setter or throw
semantics.result: original non-nullish value or assigned RHS value

caveats: C# ??= conflates JavaScript undefined unless the representation models it and can duplicate different property semantics.
Computed key expressions must not be evaluated twice.

tests.name: rhs skipped
tests.input: let n=0; const x={a:1}; x.a ??= ++n; console.log(x.a,n);

tests.name: getter once setter once
tests.input: let g=0,s=0; const x={get a(){g++;return undefined},set a(v){s++}}; x.a ??= 3; console.log(g,s);
